seo.seo_title: About us, a student company from Boden | Norden Media UF
seo.seo_description: Norden Media UF is a local media agency in Boden run by three students at Björknäsgymnasiet. We build websites and live stream events for businesses and organisations.

page_header.t4: We are a team from Boden with solid technical expertise and high standards for quality. We build websites that are fast, clear and designed to deliver results, and we stream events with the same precision. Our assignments include live streaming the business breakfasts in Boden and Boden Municipal Council meetings.

hur_vi_tanker.t21: You get a fixed price and a clear description of what is included before work begins.
hur_vi_tanker.t23: The invoice is only sent once you have reviewed and approved the finished website.
hur_vi_tanker.t25: You have one contact person, quick answers and explanations without technical detours.
hur_vi_tanker.t27: We manage and develop the website as your business grows.

after_the_uf_year.t31: The UF year is only the beginning. We plan to continue the business as a limited company, with the same team and the same commitment to our clients.
after_the_uf_year.t33: If you choose to manage it yourselves, we hand over all the material and walk you through how it works. We are happy to help with changes and further development at an hourly rate.
